authority: geometry-independent symbolic/curriculum class registry; not recognition, rank, readiness, identity, governance, or authority
purpose: Represent the intended ten-station Tree-of-Life class grammar that may repeat inside each Vitae grade without asserting a one-to-one grade-to-sefirah mapping.

sources.human_architect_input: 2026-08-23: Tree-of-Life/Kabbalah structure was the inspiration for the ten-grade system; intended curriculum grammar is ten grades with ten classes per grade.
historical_context: Sefer Yetzirah 1:1-2: ten sefirot and twenty-two foundation letters are distinguished within the thirty-two paths framework.
Standard ten-sefirah naming commonly uses Keter, Chokhmah, Binah, Chesed, Gevurah, Tiferet, Netzach, Hod, Yesod, Malkhut, with traditions differing on treatment of Da'at/Keter.
